nodes.name: A Real Plunger
nodes.flavor: The rubber band goes back in the drawer. Progress.
nodes.table_change: a brass plunger replaces the rubber band — launch power becomes chargeable

nodes.name: Second Trash Can
nodes.flavor: Twice the garbage, twice the glory.
nodes.table_change: a second dented can joins the alley

nodes.name: Third Trash Can
nodes.flavor: The classic triangle. Now it's a racket.
nodes.table_change: the bumper nest is complete

nodes.name: Corner Boys
nodes.flavor: Two guys, two folding chairs, remarkable reflexes.
nodes.table_change: slingshots appear above the flippers

nodes.name: Guard Rails
nodes.flavor: Welded by a guy who owes us.
nodes.table_change: inlane guides tame the outlanes

nodes.name: Can Deposits
nodes.flavor: Every can pays a little more. Ask us how.
nodes.table_change: the cans dent deeper and glow greedier

nodes.name: Fresh Rubbers
nodes.flavor: Red ones. The fast kind.
nodes.table_change: flipper rubbers get fresher and angrier

nodes.name: Chalk Lines
nodes.flavor: Somebody chalked the lanes. Now they count.
nodes.table_change: rollover lanes light up at the top arch

nodes.name: The Numbers Game
nodes.flavor: A bicycle wheel, a chalkboard, and suddenly everyone's a mathematician.
nodes.table_change: a bicycle-wheel spinner appears in the left lane

nodes.name: Fast Fingers
nodes.flavor: The wheel spins faster when Feets does the spinning.
nodes.table_change: playing cards appear in the spokes

nodes.name: Paper Route
nodes.flavor: More slips on the board. More work. More everything.
nodes.table_change: a third paper slip joins the job board

nodes.name: Coin-Op Washer
nodes.flavor: It washes socks. Among other things.
nodes.table_change: Lucky's window lights up; the wash loop opens

nodes.name: Bigger Safe
nodes.flavor: The old one was a shoebox. A literal shoebox.
nodes.table_change: the back-room safe visibly grows

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.flavor: Everybody gets one. Tonight, anyway.
nodes.table_change: a chalk outline marks where the ball comes back

nodes.name: Brass Balls
nodes.flavor: Say it out loud. Feels good, right?
nodes.table_change: the guys go brass — everything shines a little

nodes.name: Bench Depth
nodes.flavor: Good guys are hard to find. Adequate guys, we got.
nodes.table_change: more guys loiter in the alley art

nodes.name: Inspector's Coffee Fund
nodes.flavor: He takes it black, with two sugars and a twenty.
nodes.table_change: the Inspector's chair gets visibly comfier

nodes.name: The Wire
nodes.flavor: Three payphones, one tote board, zero honest numbers.
nodes.table_change: payphone targets and the tote board wire in

nodes.name: Bigger Book
nodes.flavor: More bets, more lightbulbs, more everything.
nodes.table_change: the tote board sprouts lightbulbs

nodes.name: Street Tax
nodes.flavor: The corner boys hold out their hats now.
nodes.table_change: the corner boys collect on every kick

nodes.name: Industrial Washers
nodes.flavor: Steam means clean. Ask anybody.
nodes.table_change: steam rises from the laundromat roof

nodes.name: Creative Accounting
nodes.flavor: The books balance. Both sets.
nodes.table_change: a suspiciously tidy ledger appears on the counter

nodes.name: Beat Cop on the Take
nodes.flavor: Officer Dooley prefers unmarked bills and glazed.
nodes.table_change: the donut-shop window lights when you can afford him

nodes.name: The Enforcer's Corner
nodes.flavor: Big Sal stands there now. Things bounce off Big Sal.
nodes.table_change: Big Sal posts up by the left outlane

nodes.name: Protection: Lucky's Laundromat
nodes.flavor: Nice wash cycle. Shame if it stopped.
nodes.table_change: Lucky's becomes a drop-target storefront you collect from

nodes.name: Protection: Nonna's Pizzeria
nodes.flavor: Nonna insists. Nonna is very persuasive.
nodes.table_change: Nonna's opens — garlic bread and collections

nodes.name: Protection: Fat Tony's Pawn
nodes.flavor: Everything's for sale. Especially the alibi.
nodes.table_change: Fat Tony's window fills with other people's stuff

nodes.name: Muscle on the Block
nodes.flavor: The block grows floors. Floors mean rent. Rent means us.
nodes.table_change: the storefronts visibly add floors

nodes.name: The Getaway Loop
nodes.flavor: Around the block in four seconds flat, tires optional.
nodes.table_change: the left orbit opens — skid marks included

nodes.name: Steel Toes
nodes.flavor: For kicking. Doors. Mostly doors.
nodes.table_change: chrome caps on the flipper bats

nodes.name: Pizzeria Books
nodes.flavor: CASH ONLY. The sign is load-bearing.
nodes.table_change: a CASH ONLY sign appears in Nonna's window

nodes.name: The Club License
nodes.flavor: Signed by three officials. Two of them exist.
nodes.table_change: scaffolding rises over the arch — THE CLUB opens upstairs

nodes.name: The Casino Wash
nodes.flavor: You gamble dirty. You win clean. The house insists.
nodes.table_change: a golden coin tray appears on the deck — winnings pay out clean

nodes.name: The High Roller Room
nodes.flavor: Velvet rope. Bad decisions. Enormous cushions.
nodes.table_change: the velvet-rope saucer opens at the top of the left lane

nodes.name: The Second Set
nodes.flavor: Smaller bats. Bigger stakes.
nodes.table_change: mini flippers bolt onto the Club deck, riding your same thumbs

nodes.name: Skids, the Wheelman
nodes.flavor: Never turns the engine off. Never explains why.
nodes.table_change: an idling car appears by the launch lane — the next guy arrives faster

nodes.name: "Numbers" Nussbaum
nodes.flavor: He doesn't launder money. He tutors it.
nodes.table_change: a green visor appears in the laundromat window

nodes.name: Big Sal
nodes.flavor: Things bounce off Big Sal. It's physics.
nodes.table_change: Big Sal leans on the outlane rail, recharging the kickback faster

nodes.name: The Professor
nodes.flavor: Cased forty banks. Robbed none. 'The math was the fun part.'
nodes.table_change: chalk trajectories appear when you case the joint (trap and hold)

nodes.name: Rosa the Fence
nodes.flavor: Knows what everything's worth. Charges accordingly.
nodes.table_change: the pawn shop gains a back room — everything sells for more

nodes.name: "Whispers" Cohen, Attorney
nodes.flavor: Has never lost a case. Has never exactly won one either.
nodes.table_change: a briefcase man loiters outside the courthouse — heat fades faster, bail costs less

nodes.name: Manny the Fix
nodes.flavor: You never see him move. Things are just... handled.
nodes.table_change: Manny scurries across the field and pockets a lit award for you

nodes.name: Eddie Odds
nodes.flavor: Eddie doesn't gamble. Eddie corrects.
nodes.table_change: Eddie lurks at the Club rail — the house forgets whose house it is

nodes.name: The Consigliere
nodes.flavor: Speaks four languages. Says almost nothing in any of them.
nodes.table_change: a chair at the long table fills early — the work board bends to you

nodes.name: Loaded Dice
nodes.flavor: They're not loaded. They're just very well informed.
nodes.table_change: one house pocket quietly repaints itself in your color

nodes.name: The Cooler's Fired
nodes.flavor: UNDER NEW MANAGEMENT, says the sign. The sign is you.
nodes.table_change: cold streaks at the tables pay back double when they break

nodes.name: Inspector's Vacation
nodes.flavor: Two weeks in Boca. Postcard says 'lean all you want.'
nodes.table_change: hitting a lit target empties the Inspector's chair for 20 seconds

nodes.name: Police Scanner
nodes.flavor: Crackles ten seconds before trouble does.
nodes.table_change: a scanner bolts onto the backbox and mutters warnings

nodes.name: Wiretap the Wire
nodes.flavor: Turns out the numbers know their number.
nodes.table_change: one payphone sparks — the next draw shows 15 seconds early

nodes.name: Rain Insurance
nodes.flavor: Terrible flood. Everything ruined. Very sad. Fully covered.
nodes.table_change: an insurance office opens across the street — one confiscation per Night, waived

nodes.name: Insurance Policy
nodes.flavor: The Inspector's report gains an asterisk. The asterisk gains a lawyer.
nodes.table_change: TILT no longer ends the guy — he limps at half value for 10 seconds

nodes.name: Right-Hand Man
nodes.flavor: Like Big Sal, but on the other side. Also somehow bigger.
nodes.table_change: a second corner boy posts up by the right outlane

nodes.name: House Rake
nodes.flavor: The house always wins. You are increasingly the house.
nodes.table_change: more tables appear on the Club floor

nodes.name: Comp'd Suite
nodes.flavor: The first bet's on the house. The house is confused about who it is.
nodes.table_change: a neon COMPS sign lights over the Club rail — one free stake per Night

nodes.name: The Docks Concession
nodes.flavor: Everything comes in through the docks. Everything.
nodes.table_change: the dockyard gates open below the block — crates, crane, and a pier you can fall off

nodes.name: Night Shipments
nodes.flavor: The manifest says fish. The fish say nothing.
nodes.table_change: more container stacks pile up on the quay

nodes.name: The Truck Route
nodes.flavor: Same city, new roads. Ours now.
nodes.table_change: the right orbit opens — the trucks run all night

nodes.name: The Penthouse
nodes.flavor: Top floor. Long table. Five chairs, and you know whose they are.
nodes.table_change: the room above the Club lights up — the calmest, most dangerous place in the city
